## Reviewer checklist

- [ ] Scope matches the requirement and preserves the agreed stack and UI baseline.
- [ ] Shared-contract changes were coordinated across mobile, web, and backend.
- [ ] Relevant checks and manual evidence are recorded.
- [ ] Diff contains no secrets, generated files, unrelated changes, or unresolved conflicts.
